description: The US stock market's state now (regular, pre-market, after-hours, overnight or closed), today's hours and when regular trading next opens, from Robinhood's own calendar, holidays included. Robinhood's stock tokens trade on chain at all hours; their reference feed is live overnight (Sunday 8 pm to Friday 8 pm ET) and frozen on weekends and holidays.
